Mistaking necessary precision for extreme fussiness

semantic_axes.description: Fussy exacting demands versus practical thorough precision

edges.boundary_rule: Fastidious implies demanding, sometimes excessively fussy standards of neatness or quality; meticulous means careful and thorough about details without that fussiness.
clues_b: checks relevant details for accuracy and function
irrelevant_clues: working slowly, a large number of steps, good results

misconceptions.M3: Assuming slow work proves either description
